# The Clearance Geeks - Waste Removals

> Waste removal and house clearance across Greater Manchester.

## Services
- House clearance
- Garden waste removal
- Office and commercial clearance
- General junk and rubbish removal
- Builders' waste
- Single item collections

## Areas
Stockport, Manchester, Salford, Trafford, Tameside, Oldham, Bolton, Bury, Rochdale, Wigan, Cheadle, Didsbury.
